Fictional regional exercise

Add two fictional cases and four staged excerpts: an unverified warning, a same-source repost, a benign explanation and an overseas repost. Training Sector R-7 and Region X-4 are fictional areas. No real threat, person, agency or event is represented.

Existing work is retained. The exercise does not incorporate evidence, assign threat probabilities or establish detection performance. Literal matching intentionally includes the benign and negated report so the analyst can examine false alarms.

Stage source document

Review training proposal

Acceptance records this exact draft as evidence and reopens a Reviewed assessment. Reject drafts that require correction; a manual analyst statement can be incorporated through Document intake. Rejection requires a note and adds no evidence. Reviewer identity and history remain unverified.

Synthetic evaluation report

Read-only results for authored synthetic controls. No AI model was evaluated. Human semantic checks remain unassessed. This report is separate from the assessment workspace and is not saved automatically.

Stage synthetic import

This built-in fictional batch contains an original report, a shared-source repost and a linked correction. No files are uploaded, no source is fetched and no evidence is automatically incorporated. Repeating an unchanged batch skips its records.
